_: Canonical source for the hub root .claude/settings.json.
Hand-edit THIS file only, then run:  <python> Drawer/settings-sync.py --apply
Git carries this source and the generated project settings. The same run writes this box's .mcp.json, which is git-ignored.
{HUB} in a hook or statusLine command becomes $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, the hub root, so the guards travel to any box or hub copy.

{ENV_PREFIX} becomes harness.toml [project] env_prefix. The Flight hooks run behind a shell guard: <env_prefix>_FLIGHT set (a headless Flight run sets it) or a {HUB}/Flight/seats folder (a hand Flight seated by flight-hooks.py seat); Drawer/flight-hooks.py then exits 0 for a session whose payload session_id holds no seat.

{MEM_SERVER} becomes the memory MCP server name and {MEM_TOOLS} its tool prefix, both from harness.toml [mem] server_name. {EDITOR_SERVER} becomes the editor MCP server name from harness.toml [product] mcp_server; with no name or no mcp_url it drops out of every server list.

Every hook runs through Drawer/hooks/run-hook.sh <boot|gate|pass> <script> [args]: it picks the hub .venv interpreter, then py, then a real python3, and with no Python at all a boot announces HUB SETUP REQUIRED, a gate denies all but the preparation command, a pass exits 0.
A PreToolUse matcher of {GATES} renders from the GATES table in Drawer/project-gate.py; the table is the one home for the gate registrations.

root lists the capability classes of the one target, the hub root: every session seats there. A class's skills are model-invocable there; every other project skill is user-invocable only. Each harness.toml [project] task_skills entry must be visible there.

Required Claude behavior lives in each project .claude/settings.json: the status line, effort, the STE-100 output style (.claude/output-styles/ste100.md), skill overrides and empty commit and PR attribution (clean human commits, no AI attribution lines). The lead model defaults to Opus at medium effort; the human changes it from there.

local renders to .claude/settings.local.json, box-local and git-ignored like .mcp.json, because its folders are this box's absolute paths. It is a short permissions.allow list (settings-sync adds this box's hub interpreter), permissions.additionalDirectories for the product task trees (<product repo>_wt), the hub task worktrees (<hub>_wt), state_root and the temp folders, and these hooks. {LEG_SEAT} becomes a lean SubagentStart boot: one SEAT line of those folders for an implementer or workflow-leg leg, printed with no Python start. The local key takes permissions.allow and hooks only: never a mode, an env or a blanket allow, so nothing runs with permissions bypassed.
skillOverrides sets rarely used bundled Claude Code skills to name-only (an account skill a box adds is not named here); a plugin skill ignores skillOverrides.

engine_editor.access: The optional single-driver tool server ([product] mcp_server), for the session that drives it

operator_stewardship.access: Hub estate, rulings, and harness health workflows

review.access: Review advice: the milestone-close cold audit

memory.access: Hub memory: design, decisions, taste, lessons, facts and the task board
